summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish a grant program for nonprofit organizations to promote caregiver wellness through various support services and activities, including mental health services, transportation, and holistic wellness programs.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a grant program to support caregiver wellness, including providing mental health services and holistic wellness programs to caregivers. This directly relates to healthcare access and support for a specific population, pushing towards more public support for health services.

The bill creates a new grant program to provide support services like meals, transportation, and mental health services to caregivers, aiming to strengthen caregiver retention and reduce burnout. This expands government-funded support for a vulnerable population, thus expanding the social safety net.
